name: MCE Rejected Transactions
query:
SELECT
  name as "Transaction:Link/MCE Inventory Transaction:160",
  transaction_type as "Type:Data:70",
  voucher_id as "Voucher ID:Data:150",
  posting_date as "Posting Date:Date:110",
  source_warehouse_no as "Source WH Code:Data:110",
  target_warehouse_no as "Target WH Code:Data:110",
  supplier_raw as "Supplier (Raw):Data:110",
  rejection_reason as "Rejection Reason:Small Text:420",
  request_id as "Request ID:Data:100",
  api_log as "API Log:Link/MCE API Log:150",
  creation as "Received On:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabMCE Inventory Transaction`
WHERE validation_status = 'Rejected'
ORDER BY creation DESC
